Operation Paraquet
South Georgia, South Atlantic
25th April 1982 0600 Local
Captain Brian Young, HMS Antrim, Task Force 317.9
From Northwood
Argentinian forces occupy Grytviken the main settlement on South Georgia. SBS has confirmed the presence of the ARA Santa Fe, a Balao class submarine.
The ARA Santa Fe has dropped off supplies during the night and is likely heading out to sea in an attempt to return to the Falklands.
The cabinet has approved Operation Paraquet. It is vital to show the world Britian intends to fight and recover the Falklands through military force if necessary.
Objectives:
OBJ ALPHA CAPTURE Bring the task force to within bombardment range of Grytviken. It is expected the Argentinian garrison will surrender under this threat. If necessary provide naval gunfire support and capture Grytviken with your embarked marines.
OBJ BETA NEUTRALISE Use the helicopters of the task force to locate and neutralise the ARA Santa Fe. This will be the first time a navy conducts ASW operations in this manner. Trust in your training and crews. Imperative:
Ensure no damage to the task force. Advisory:
South Georgia is extremely inhospitable. Cold weather gear must be issued. Expect issues operating rotary wing aircraft in extreme conditions.
For the Service.
